'''Kevin Hervey''' (born July 9, 1996)<ref>{{cite web|title=25 - Kevin Hervey|url=http://www.nbadraft.net/players/kevin-hervey|website=NBA Draft.net|accessdate=June 13, 2017}}</ref> is an American basketball player. He played college basketball for the [[University of Texas at Arlington]].

== College career ==
Hervey played four years for the [[Texas–Arlington Mavericks men's basketball|Texas–Arlington Mavericks]]. In his sophomore season, Hervey averaged 18.1 points and 9.8 rebounds per game. He missed the last 19 games of the season due to a [[torn ACL]] in his left knee.

As a junior, Hervey averaged 17.1 points and 8.5 rebounds per game but had some lingering effects from the ACL tear in the early season. He led the Mavericks to a 27-9 season, the most wins in school history, and NIT quarterfinal run. He was named [[Sun Belt Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Sun Belt Conference Player of the Year]] and earned all-district honors from both the [[National Association of Basketball Coaches]] and the [[U.S. Basketball Writers Association]]. Hervey is the second Texas–Arlington player after [[Marquez Haynes]] to be named an [[Associated Press|AP]] Honorable Mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Martinez|first1=Matthew|title=UTA’s Hervey becomes school’s second-ever AP All-American|url=http://www.star-telegram.com/sports/college/mens-basketball/article141463124.html|accessdate=June 13, 2017|work=[[Fort Worth Star-Telegram]]|date=March 29, 2017}}</ref> He was twice named Sun Belt Player of the Week, on December 6, 2016 and February 20, 2017.<ref name="SUN BELT POY">{{cite press release|url=http://sunbeltsports.org/news/2017/3/5/GENERAL_0305170603.aspx?path=mbball |title=UTA’s Hervey, Cross cap memorable season with individual honors |publisher=Sun Belt Conference |date=March 6, 2017 |accessdate=March 7, 2017}}</ref>

As a senior, Hervey averaged 21.1 points and 8.7 rebounds per game. He was named to the first-team All-Sun Belt team for the second consecutive year.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.utamavs.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030518aaa.html|title=MBB:  Hervey, Neal earn all-Sun Belt honors|access-date=2018-04-20}}</ref>
